source.quote: Audiophonics' own product page, read 2026-11-27, for a bare DAC module. « Puce DAC | ESS ES9018K2M »; « PCM jusqu'à 32bit 384kHz »; « DSD jusqu'au DSD256 »; inputs « 1x I2S (XH 2.54mm 6 pôles) » and « 1x SPDIF sur pastilles à souder », chosen by a jumper; output RCA « 2Vrms ».

_maker_terms: See brands/audiophonics.json: the maker's terms forbid reproduction; recorded on the project owner's decision of 2026-11-27, pending written permission.
_the_ceilings_are_the_i2s_ones: The page gives one rate line for the board. S/PDIF cannot carry 384 kHz, so the figures are written on the I2S input only and the S/PDIF block is left empty.
_a_buyer_reports_192: A customer review on the same page says the board, left unprogrammed, stops at 192 kHz. A review is not the maker; noted, not recorded.
